purpose: Download plain-text logs for a single workflow job. Used as the substitute for the broken run-wide logs endpoint (`actions/download-workflow-run-logs`, which returns 500 through jentic because jentic can't follow the 302 → zip-archive redirect). Caller enumerates jobs via list_jobs_for_workflow_run and concatenates per-job log bodies. For terraform-test.yml each run currently has a single job, so this is a one-call substitute in practice.
